overview: Student hosts announced a state sportsmanship award win for members of the broadcast team and presented features on the Krystle Campbell Scholarship fund, a new guidance counselor, and Spirit Week.

items.title: Introduction and MIAA Sportsmanship Award
items.summary: Student anchors open the broadcast and announce that Mustang Report team members won first place in the MIAA Sportsmanship Award competition.

items.title: Krystle Campbell Memorial and Scholarship Feature
items.summary: A featured video honors alumnus Krystle Campbell, highlighting the annual softball tournament and scholarship fund established in her memory.

items.title: Interview with Guidance Counselor Mr. Klein
items.summary: New guidance counselor Mr. Klein discusses his work organizing C3 Day and his approach to student goal planning.

items.title: Spirit Week and Halloween Coverage
items.summary: The broadcast highlights Spirit Week activities and features a Halloween haiku written by student Cullen Burke.
